FN-PZZ0RG-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 97
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/26/2023
Senate Bill 97 as reported by the Committee on Judiciary could increase the administrative
obligations of the Department of Corrections to notify prisoners of any outstanding charge(s)
that would prohibit them from being considered for parole, per the provisions of this bill.
